provenance.population_note: Main ranking uses eligible mission-scoped holdout users. Ablation uses a seeded random subset of those users with a paired baseline. No test-based configuration selection.

test_set.relevance_definition: Products with positive events in the temporal holdout after excluding products already seen in training.

EXP-006.label: Hybrid plus mission without basket optimization

SIMPLE-CHEAPEST.label: Cheapest eligible item per category, no joint optimization
SIMPLE-CHEAPEST.score_definition: Same hybrid-mission score as EXP-007; conditional on feasible baskets.

SIMPLE-FIXED.label: Fixed highest-rating catalog curation per category, no test-label selection
SIMPLE-FIXED.score_definition: Same hybrid-mission score as EXP-007; conditional on feasible baskets.

base_all_signals.note: Full configuration on a subset of 180 test users.

no_collaborative_signal.note: Ablation on a subset of 180 test users.

no_content_signal.note: Ablation on a subset of 180 test users.

no_mission_signal.note: Ablation on a subset of 180 test users.

no_quality_signal.note: Ablation on a subset of 180 test users.

no_affinity_signal.note: Ablation on a subset of 180 test users. Components affinity are already zero in the selected configuration, so this variant is identical to the baseline.

no_exposure_adjustment.note: Controlled exposure is compared under the same hybrid-mission configuration.

without_constraints.label: Hybrid plus mission without basket optimization

no_basket_constraints.note: Without hard constraints, the system selects the top product per category without checking total budget or merchant count.

ab_simulation.label: OFFLINE SIMULATION. Assignment is not randomized across live sessions and does not establish causality.

session_2_items.context: the final two interactions as anonymous session context

no_history.context: no history; mission, content, and popularity only

cold_start_simulation.note: Cold start is simulated by hiding history for the same users; this does not represent real new users or production performance.

notes: All data is synthetic; the values do not represent a real marketplace.
Ranking metrics use a per-user temporal holdout.
EXP-007 uses basket metrics because its objective is combination optimization.
The A/B simulation is not an online experiment and must not be presented as causal evidence.
